title: Pre-Registered Multi-Engagement Falsification Protocol
author: Cut the Cake Research Team
description: Pre-registered hypotheses, sealed route mappings, and falsification criteria for Milestone 5-B cross-section evaluation prior to model execution.

independent_sources: Blitz.gg Valorant Strategy Guides: Ascent A-Site Execution & Wine Clearing
VLR.gg Pro Tactical Breakdown: A-Main Wine Crossfire Defense
ascent_a_main.declared_model_boundary: 2D Ground-plane encounter; Heaven/Rafters verticality explicitly excluded as 2D model limitation.

blinded_mapping.route_A: Layered Wine slice clearing off-angle before site commit
blinded_mapping.route_B: Direct center dry rush down A-Main choke into site

evaluation_interval_m.description: A-Main choke mouth to Wine pocket threshold

pre_registered_hypotheses.approach_suffix_margin: min_{s in [8, 16]} M_suffix(route_A, s) > min_{s in [8, 16]} M_suffix(route_B, s)
pre_registered_hypotheses.falsification_criterion: If route_B achieves equal or higher approach suffix margin than route_A, the off-angle serialization hypothesis is falsified.

independent_sources: HLTV.org Tactical Fundamentals: Dust II Upper B Choke Vulnerability
Valve Source Overview Metadata: de_dust2 pos_x=-2476, pos_y=3239, scale=4.4
dust2_b_tunnels.declared_model_boundary: Dry entry without tactical utility; multi-angle crossfire cannot be serialized by 2D geometry.

evaluation_interval_m.description: Immediate tunnel exit threshold into B site crossfire

pre_registered_hypotheses.choke_crossfire_collapse: Both dry routes experience immediate K_LOS >= 2 exposure upon crossing exit threshold (s in [0, 4]m).
pre_registered_hypotheses.critical_exit_deficit: min_{s in [0, 6]} M_suffix(s) <= 0 for both routes (model must refuse to manufacture false serialization).
pre_registered_hypotheses.falsification_criterion: If either dry route achieves positive suffix margin (M_suffix >= +1) on exit, the choke crossfire hypothesis is falsified.

transit_213.topological_mechanism: Occluder Lattice / Concealed Movement vs Open Lot Exposure
independent_sources: Infinity Ward Official Tactical Overview: Transit 213 Central Lot Bus Cover vs Perimeter Sightlines
Activision Tactical Map Reference: Transit 213 Rusting Bus Corridors
transit_213.declared_model_boundary: Planar vehicular bounding-box occluders on flat parking lot.

blinded_mapping.route_A: Weaves through bus lattice corridor using vehicular cover
blinded_mapping.route_B: Direct push across open north lot lane with zero cover

evaluation_interval_m.description: Central bus parking lot transit zone

pre_registered_hypotheses.lot_suffix_margin: min_{s in [6, 18]} M_suffix(route_A, s) > min_{s in [6, 18]} M_suffix(route_B, s)
pre_registered_hypotheses.falsification_criterion: If route_B achieves earlier cover or superior suffix margin over route_A, the occluder lattice hypothesis is falsified.
